_comment: PER-ABILITY VFX. Content, not code: adding or restyling an ability's effects must not need an engine or renderer change. Keyed by character, then by ability id. `packages/client/src/ability-vfx.ts` reads this and decides what to draw; the renderer only executes. Colours are duplicated from each character's `magic` block in data/art/<id>.json rather than imported, because that file is an art SOURCE (thesis, build, garment) and does not ship to the browser. `ability-vfx.test.ts` asserts the two agree, so the copy cannot drift.

aegis._thesis: Never warm. A paladin's light is given to him; Aegis forces his. Pale, sickly, effortful.

shield_bash._comment: A cone at range 2. Nothing flies; the door does the work. All of the effect is at the far end.

barrier_pulse._comment: He pushes it out of himself and it lands on someone else — so both ends show, and the near end is the effortful one.

intercept._comment: The blink. He casts, then he is simply somewhere else — see `blink` in animate.ts. A ring at the square he leaves and another where he arrives, so the eye can follow a unit that never crossed the space between.

warding_halo._comment: The ultimate. Bigger and slower than anything else he does, because it is the one time the effort pays off.

wisp._thesis: One smoke language, reused at different intensities so four abilities read as one character. Cold plum, never warm — the same misdirection whether she is leaving a square, arriving at one, or leaving a decoy behind. The constant AMBIENT smoke is not here: it lives in the client's ambient-motion layer, never state-driven, so the decoy can mimic it (docs/design/wisp.md §8, §9).

dagger_flurry._comment: A melee cone. Nothing flies — the daggers do the work where she stands, so all the effect is the impact and a low burst of debris.

bola._comment: Thrown down a line. The one thing of hers that crosses the board, so it keeps its tracer; the slow lands as a lingering low ring on the target.

blink._comment: The dodge. She does not cross the space — a ring of smoke where she leaves (deep, the effortful near end) and another where she arrives (core), so the eye can follow a unit that was never in between. See `blink` in animate.ts.

veil_decoy._comment: The vanish. A single soft fade at her square as the smoke closes over her — the same material the decoy is made of, which is the point. Self-cast, so nothing flies.

shadowstep_strike._comment: The ultimate. Bigger and slower than the plain blink — the one arrival that costs 100 energy — and it lands damage, so both ends show and the far end bursts.
